prompt: IMPORTANT: the white cat MUST REMAIN A REAL PHOTOGRAPHED CAT in every frame - individual hairs, natural fur, real whiskers, normal cat eyes. Never smooth, never glossy, never cartoonish, never a plush toy. It never turns into a person. The cat stays HUGE - as tall as a heavyweight fighter - and stays STANDING UPRIGHT ON ITS HIND LEGS for the entire shot; it never drops onto all four paws. The man stays TINY, about one metre tall, reaching only to the cat's knee. Neither changes size at any moment. Plain live television look: no sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Bare knuckles with thin hand wraps, no boxing gloves. Anatomy correct: no twisted joints, no rubbery limbs. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring. Timing, follow it exactly: SECONDS 0-3: THE JOKE IS THAT THE CAT NEVER LOOKS AT HIM. The tiny fighter is right at the cat's leg, hammering punch after punch into its shin as hard as he can, six or seven punches, completely serious and furious. The cat does not react at all: it is looking away across the arena, lifts one front paw and calmly licks it, as if it were alone in the ring. Not once does it glance down at him. SECONDS 3-4: still without looking at him, still licking its paw, the cat's long thick tail swings around behind it in a wide fast arc, like a baseball bat. SECONDS 4-5: the tail catches the tiny man square across the chest - the contact is clearly visible - and he is launched sideways COMPLETELY OUT OF THE FRAME. After that he is not visible at all. SECONDS 5-8: the cat is alone, still standing upright, still not looking where he went. It finishes licking its paw, lowers it, and only at the very last moment turns its head and glances briefly toward the empty spot on the canvas. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the ring and both fighters sharp, the crowd and the banners out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Real speed, natural motion blur. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: arena crowd, a rapid series of small dull punches on the cat's leg that clearly do nothing, the crowd starting to laugh, then one heavy whoosh and a loud thud as the tail connects, then the crowd erupts. No music, no commentary, no speech.
